hooks.name: Journal entry on spec task completion
hooks.description: When a spec task is completed, append a short entry to the Kiro journal describing what was done and which Kiro feature helped.

action.prompt: A spec task was just marked complete. Append a short entry (2-3 sentences) to docs/kiro-journal.md: the spec and task that finished, what was built, and which Kiro feature helped (spec workflow, steering, a hook, property-based tests, etc.). Keep it concise and factual. Create docs/kiro-journal.md if it does not exist. Do not duplicate an entry that is already there.
